$comment: Generated from the tool definitions of the Emelia MCP server. Do not edit by hand.

server.name: emelia
server.title: Emelia
server.description: Cold email and LinkedIn outreach: campaigns, lists, contacts, email and phone finder, warmup.

toolsets.title: Campaigns
toolsets.summary: List and read campaigns, create drafts, statistics per step, latest activities and replies, manual tasks.

toolsets.title: Lists and contacts
toolsets.summary: Create, rename and delete lists; add contacts one by one or 100 at a time, update, find and delete them.

toolsets.title: Enrichment
toolsets.summary: Find a professional email or a phone number, verify an email, read a job that was still running.

toolsets.title: Deliverability
toolsets.summary: Sending mailboxes, disconnected mailboxes, warmup status and score, turning warmup on.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List all campaigns of the Emelia account (multichannel: email + LinkedIn steps in one campaign), with their id, name and status.

tools.name: get_campaign
tools.title: Get campaign details
tools.description: Get the full configuration of a campaign: status, schedule, steps, and the contact lists attached to it (recipients.lists) or excluded from it (recipients.excludedLists), each with id, name and contact count. To manage the contacts of an attached list (add, update, search, delete), use the list tools with the list id.

tools.name: create_campaign
tools.title: Create a campaign
tools.description: Create a new draft campaign with the given name. The campaign is created empty: steps, schedule and sending identities are configured in the Emelia app for now. Attach contacts by adding them to a list that the campaign uses.
notes: The sequence, the schedule, the senders and the lists of the campaign are set in the Emelia app: the MCP server cannot change them yet.

tools.name: get_campaign_stats
tools.title: Get campaign statistics
tools.description: Get the statistics of a campaign: global metrics (sent, opens, clicks, replies, bounces...) and a breakdown per step. Optionally restrict to a date range with start/end (ISO dates).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start date (ISO 8601) to filter the stats

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: End date (ISO 8601) to filter the stats

notes: `end` is an exact bound: a date without a time excludes that day.
On an unknown campaign id the error reads like an invalid API key. Check the campaign id first.

tools.name: get_campaign_activities
tools.title: Get campaign activities
tools.description: Get the activity feed of a campaign (sent, opened, clicked, replied, bounced, LinkedIn events...). Replied activities include the reply content. Filter by activity type or contact.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by activity type (e.g. REPLIED, OPENED, SENT)

notes: Returns the most recent page only (30 activities). For the full history, use the REST API or the CSV export of the campaign.

Main `type` values: `SENT`, `OPENED`, `CLICKED`, `MAIL_REPLIED`, `BOUNCED`, `UNSUBSCRIBED`, `VISITED`, `INVITED`, `ACCEPTED`, `MESSAGE_SENT`, `INMAIL_SENT`, `LINKEDIN_REPLIED`, `WHATSAPP_REPLIED`, `TASK_COMPLETED`, `TASK_FAILED`. For replies, use `MAIL_REPLIED` or `LINKEDIN_REPLIED` (not `REPLIED`).

tools.name: list_manual_tasks
tools.title: List pending manual tasks
tools.description: List the pending manual tasks of a campaign (steps that require a human action, e.g. a LinkedIn touch done by hand). Each task carries the contact, the step id (taskId) and its name.

tools.name: complete_manual_task
tools.title: Set a manual task status
tools.description: Mark a pending manual task as completed ('ok') or failed ('ko') for a contact in a campaign.

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: The step ID of the manual task

tools.name: create_list
tools.title: Create a list
tools.description: Create an empty contact list. Then add contacts with add_contact_to_list or add_contacts_to_list_bulk. Attach the list to a campaign in the Emelia app to have its contacts flow into the campaign automatically.

tools.name: list_lists
tools.title: List all lists
tools.description: List the contact lists of the account, with pagination, name search and filters. Lists created by a LinkedIn scrape appear here too (filter with source). Returns each list with its id, name and contact counters.

tools.name: get_list
tools.title: Get list details
tools.description: Get a list by id: name, contact counters (leads, emails, phones, linkedins), source and status.

tools.name: rename_list
tools.title: Rename a list
tools.description: Rename a list.

tools.name: delete_list
tools.title: Delete a list
tools.description: Permanently delete a list AND all its contacts. This cannot be undone; confirm with the user before calling it.
notes: Deletes every contact of the list for good.

tools.name: get_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts of a list
tools.description: Paginated listing of the contacts of a list. To check whether a specific contact exists (and get its leadId for update/delete), pass email or linkedinUrl instead: it returns the exact matches only. email and linkedinUrl are mutually exclusive and take precedence over search/pagination.

parameters.name: linkedinUrl
parameters.description: Exact contact lookup by LinkedIn profile URL

tools.name: get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get a single contact of a list by its leadId (returned by add_contact_to_list or the email/linkedinUrl lookup of get_list_contacts).

tools.name: add_contact_to_list
tools.title: Add a contact to a list
tools.description: Add a single contact to a list. If the list is used by one or several campaigns, the contact automatically enters those campaigns; this is the standard way to feed a running campaign. Flat object: field names as keys (contact fields like firstName/email/phone/linkedinUrlProfile, company fields like companyName/websiteUrl, or your custom variables; human-readable names work too). Any unrecognized key creates a new custom variable automatically. Duplicates (same email or LinkedIn URL already in the list) are not re-created: the response returns the existing leadId with duplicate: true. Set updateIfExists to true to update the existing contact instead (add-or-update).

parameters.name: contact
parameters.description: The contact fields, flat key → value

parameters.name: updateIfExists
parameters.description: Update the existing contact when a duplicate is found

notes: Contact fields are a flat object: standard fields (`firstName`, `lastName`, `email`, `phone`, `linkedinUrlProfile`, `jobTitle`), company fields (`companyName`, `websiteUrl`) or your custom variables.

tools.name: add_contacts_to_list_bulk
tools.title: Add contacts in bulk
tools.description: Add up to 100 contacts to a list in one call (same behavior as add_contact_to_list for each row: campaign propagation, duplicate detection, updateIfExists). Flat object: field names as keys (contact fields like firstName/email/phone/linkedinUrlProfile, company fields like companyName/websiteUrl, or your custom variables; human-readable names work too). Any unrecognized key creates a new custom variable automatically. Rows are processed independently; the response reports created/duplicates/updated/failed counts and a per-row result.

parameters.name: contacts
parameters.description: The contacts, one flat object each (max 100)

parameters.name: updateIfExists
parameters.description: Update existing contacts when duplicates are found

notes: Loading 1,000 contacts is 10 calls of 100, not 1,000 single calls.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: Update a contact by its leadId (its list is derived automatically). Flat object: field names as keys (contact fields like firstName/email/phone/linkedinUrlProfile, company fields like companyName/websiteUrl, or your custom variables; human-readable names work too). Any unrecognized key creates a new custom variable automatically. The fields you send overwrite the contact's values; fields you don't send stay untouched. If the contact's list is used by campaigns, the updated values are propagated to them.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: The fields to update, flat key → value

tools.name: delete_contact
tools.title: Delete a contact
tools.description: Permanently delete a contact from a list (and its company data). If the list is used by campaigns, the contact is also removed from those campaigns. Cannot be undone; confirm with the user before calling it. Find the leadId with the email/linkedinUrl lookup of get_list_contacts.
notes: Deletes the contact for good and removes it from its campaigns.

tools.name: find_contact
tools.title: Find a contact across all lists
tools.description: Search a contact across ALL the lists of the account by email address or LinkedIn profile URL. Returns the lists that contain the contact and the contact data itself. Use this to answer "do we already have this person?" or to locate a contact before updating or deleting it.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Email address or LinkedIn profile URL

tools.name: find_email
tools.title: Find an email address
tools.description: Consumes credits. Find the professional email address of a person with Emelia's email finder, from their full name and company. Waits for the result (usually a few seconds). qualification is 'valid' or 'invalid'.
tools.credits: 1 credit, refunded when no email is found

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country code (e.g. FR, US) to localize the search

notes: Always pass `country` (an ISO code such as `FR` or `US`): the tool marks it optional, but the search is refused without it.
A second call starts a second search, billed again. If a job is still running, read it with `get_enrichment_result`.

tools.name: find_phone
tools.title: Find a phone number
tools.description: Consumes credits. Find the phone number of a person with Emelia's phone finder, from their LinkedIn profile URL. Waits for the result. qualification is 'found' or 'not_found'.
tools.credits: 50 credits, refunded when no number is found

parameters.name: linkedinUrl
parameters.description: LinkedIn profile URL of the person

notes: A number already found in the last 6 months comes back at once and costs the same.

tools.name: verify_email
tools.title: Verify an email address
tools.description: Consumes credits. Verify the deliverability of an email address with Emelia's email verifier. Waits for the result. qualification is 'valid' or 'invalid'.

tools.name: get_enrichment_result
tools.title: Get an enrichment job result
tools.description: Fetch the result of a previously started enrichment job (find_email, find_phone or verify_email) by its jobId. Use it when one of those tools reported the job was still running.

tools.name: list_email_providers
tools.title: List email providers
tools.description: List the sending email accounts (providers) connected to Emelia, with sensitive data masked. Useful for deliverability audits: spot disconnected accounts with disconnectedOnly.

tools.name: get_warmup_status
tools.title: Get warmup status
tools.description: Get the warmup status of the email providers (10 per page): running or not, score, emails sent/received, spam count. A low score signals a deliverability problem.
notes: Every mailbox comes back in one call, whatever `page` you pass.

tools.name: set_warmup
tools.title: Enable or disable warmup
tools.description: Enable or disable the email warmup for a provider (providerId comes from list_email_providers or get_warmup_status).

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: true to enable warmup, false to disable it

notes: Turning the warmup off (`enabled: false`) does not work yet: turn it off in the Emelia app.
